**Low-Resolution Pass:** Render the cloud volume at resolution $R_{low}$ (where $R_{low} \ll R_{target}$).
**Analysis:** Compute a metric from $I_{low}$ to determine which pixels require higher resolution.
**High-Resolution Pass:** Render the cloud volume at resolution $R_{target}$.
For pixels identified in the analysis step, perform full high-resolution ray marching.
**Accumulation:** Combine the results from the low-resolution and high-resolution passes to form the final image $I$.
